name: My Bed, Your Grave
source:
Lethia and Thana can't be within an arms distance without death coming between them. Since the moment they'd met, they've played a violent game of push and pull. After all, they're a vampire and a werewolf, how could they be anything but natural enemies? But after over three hundred years of blood and tears, Lethia decides she no longer wishes to participate in this game, and the only way it ends...is with Thana killing her.

[From [url=https://safffeine.itch.io/my-bed-your-grave]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莱西亚（Lethia）和塔纳（Thana）不可能在没有死亡的情况下处于一臂距离之内。从他们认识的那一刻起，他们就开始了一场激烈的推拉游戏。毕竟吸血鬼和狼人，怎么可能不是天敌呢？但在经历了三百年的血泪之后，莱西亚决定不再参加这场游戏，而结束的唯一方式……就是塔娜杀了她。

[来自[url=https://safffeine.itch.io/my-bed-your-grave]itch.io[/url]]
